description: Scaffold the Next.js 15 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind 3.4 project inside datadive-web, install and pin the full locked dependency set (design §2), author all config enforcing the design invariants, initialize an ISOLATED git repo inside datadive-web with .gitignore and a rev-parse verification before any commit (design §21), copy the three brand PNGs + generate the app/ icon set and raster PNG seed placeholders (§8/§24), wire theme tokens + fonts + global layout shell (§16), and write .env.example (§20). Independent foundation — all later FEATs depend on it.
steps: Read design.md §2 (locked stack), §4 (folder layout), §16 (theme tokens/fonts), §20 (env vars), §21 (git isolation), §24 (asset handling) FIRST. All paths target c:\Users\Syed Mehdi Abbas\Downloads\datadive\datadive-web explicitly.

Scaffold Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, src/ dir, import alias @/*) into datadive-web. Because datadive-web\.agents\ pre-exists, create-next-app will refuse the non-empty dir: scaffold into datadive-web\.scaffold-tmp then move generated files up into datadive-web\ (preserving .agents\) and delete .scaffold-tmp. An equivalent hand-written scaffold (package.json + config + npm install) is acceptable — the design mandates the resulting stack, not the tool. Set tsconfig.json strict:true. Pin next@15, react@19, react-dom@19, typescript@5, tailwindcss@3.4.x, postcss, autoprefixer.

Install + pin the rest of the design §2 stack in package.json: runtime next-auth@5.0.0-beta.25 (EXACT), @vercel/blob, react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers, react-markdown, remark-gfm, rehype-sanitize, framer-motion, lucide-react; dev vitest, @vitejs/plugin-react, eslint-config-prettier, prettier, sharp. Add scripts: dev, build, start, lint, test (vitest run), test:watch (vitest). Add .nvmrc (Node 20) + package.json engines.

Author config: next.config.ts (images.remotePatterns host *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com ONLY; dangerouslyAllowSVG OFF — §10/§19); ESLint extends next/core-web-vitals + eslint-config-prettier + a no-restricted-imports rule forbidding imports of src/lib/airtable/client (and raw Airtable REST layer) outside src/lib/airtable/** (§3/§15); tailwind.config.ts with the §16 dark theme tokens (bg/surface/card/border/text/muted/brand/depth), accent roles (amber/red/green/blue), type scale, and font CSS variables; vitest.config.ts (node/jsdom, no network).

GIT ISOLATION (before any commit): run `git init` with cwd=datadive-web. Then run `git -C "c:\Users\Syed Mehdi Abbas\Downloads\datadive\datadive-web" rev-parse --show-toplevel` and confirm it equals the datadive-web path. If it resolves to the home dir, STOP — do not git add/commit. Write datadive-web\.gitignore excluding node_modules/, .next/, out/, .vercel/, .env* (with !.env.example), *.log, coverage, desktop.ini, Thumbs.db, .DS_Store (.agents/ stays tracked). Stage specific files (never `git add .`) and make the initial commit on the default branch.

Assets (§8/§24): copy from the parent dir c:\Users\Syed Mehdi Abbas\Downloads\datadive\ into datadive-web\public\brand\ — 'Datadive logo file-01.png'->datadive-logo-color.png, 'Datadive white logo-01.png'->datadive-logo-white.png, 'Datadive.png'->datadive-mark.png (ignore the two unused 400-square variants). Write scripts/gen-assets.mjs (sharp) to generate from the 400-square mark the App Router icons UNDER app/: src/app/icon.png, src/app/apple-icon.png, src/app/favicon.ico (N8), and small RASTER PNG placeholders in public/seed/ (project/avatar/logo/cover). NEVER SVG (§8/F2). Do NOT open any large parent-dir media.

Theme/fonts/shell (§16/§18): globals.css with Tailwind layers + CSS custom properties for the §16 tokens; wire next/font/google Inter (body) + Plus Jakarta Sans (display) + JetBrains Mono (data) as CSS variables consumed by tailwind.config.ts; root src/app/layout.tsx sets <html> dark theme, metadataBase (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL -> VERCEL_URL -> localhost), fonts, skip-to-content link; keep a minimal placeholder src/app/page.tsx until FEAT-004.

Write datadive-web\.env.example documenting every §20 variable with safe placeholders + one-line descriptions (AIRTABLE_API_KEY, AIRTABLE_BASE_ID, optional AIRTABLE_TABLE_*, AUTH_SECRET, AUTH_GOOGLE_ID, AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET, ADMIN_EMAILS, BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, REVALIDATE_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY, CONTACT_NOTIFY_TO); state all are optional for build/public render. No real secrets.

Set FEAT-001 status to completed in this file and record in findings anything later FEATs need (final dependency versions actually resolved, exact brand/seed asset filenames + dimensions, the default git branch name, and any scaffold deviation). Commit locally inside datadive-web (never push).
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` then `npm run build` in datadive-web succeed with ZERO env vars.
`git -C "...\datadive-web" rev-parse --show-toplevel` resolves to the datadive-web path (NOT home), and `git status` does not list home-directory files.
.gitignore excludes node_modules/.next/.env*/.vercel and keeps !.env.example; .env.example documents every §20 var.
public/brand/ has the 3 renamed brand PNGs; src/app/ has icon.png + apple-icon.png + favicon.ico; public/seed/ has non-empty raster PNG placeholders (no SVG).
next.config.ts restricts images.remotePatterns to the Blob host with dangerouslyAllowSVG OFF; ESLint has the airtable no-restricted-imports boundary rule.
verification: cd datadive-web && npm install && npm run build  (zero env — must pass)
git -C "c:\Users\Syed Mehdi Abbas\Downloads\datadive\datadive-web" rev-parse --show-toplevel  (must equal the datadive-web path)
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED (zero env): `npm run build` (Next 15.5.28) succeeds, `npm run lint` clean, `npx vitest run` passes (no tests yet, passWithNoTests). GIT ISOLATION CONFIRMED: ran `git init` with cwd=datadive-web; `git -C "...\datadive-web" rev-parse --show-toplevel` = C:/Users/Syed Mehdi Abbas/Downloads/datadive/datadive-web (NOT home). Default branch: master. Initial commit staged specific files only (never `git add .`, never pushed).

SCAFFOLD: hand-written scaffold (not create-next-app) per step allowance — avoids the .agents/ non-empty-dir refusal; resulting stack matches design §2. src/ dir, @/* alias, tsconfig strict:true.

RESOLVED DEPENDENCY VERSIONS (from package.json/lockfile): next 15.5.28, react 19.3.1, react-dom 19.3.1, next-auth 5.0.0-beta.25 (EXACT pin), @vercel/blob 2.8.2, react-hook-form 7.90.0, zod 3.25.76 (pinned to v3 line — @hookform/resolvers@6 had an ERESOLVE effect peer conflict), @hookform/resolvers 3.10.0, react-markdown 10.1.0, remark-gfm 4.0.1, rehype-sanitize 6.0.0, framer-motion 14.3.1, lucide-react 1.59.0. Dev: typescript 5.9.3, @types/node 20.19.43, @types/react 19.3.0, @types/react-dom 19.3.0, tailwindcss 3.4.x, postcss 8.5.31, autoprefixer 10.6.1, eslint 8.57.1 (pinned v8 so `next lint` + .eslintrc.json work), eslint-config-next 15.5.28, eslint-config-prettier 10.1.8, prettier 3.9.10, vitest 2.1.9 (pinned v2 — vitest@5 required @types/node>=22, conflicts with Node 20 target), @vitejs/plugin-react 4.7.0, sharp 0.35.5, jsdom (added for the vitest jsdom env). Local Node runtime is v24.11.1; engines set to node>=20 (not a hard 20.x pin) so builds run on the installed v24; .nvmrc=20.

ASSETS (exact filenames + dims): public/brand/datadive-logo-color.png (from 'Datadive logo file-01.png', ~1667², 76996 B), public/brand/datadive-logo-white.png (from 'Datadive white logo-01.png', 74864 B), public/brand/datadive-mark.png (from 'Datadive.png', 400², 21404 B). Generated via scripts/gen-assets.mjs (sharp): src/app/icon.png (512²), src/app/apple-icon.png (180²), src/app/favicon.ico (32² PNG wrapped in a hand-built ICO container — sharp cannot emit .ico natively). Raster PNG seed placeholders in public/seed/: project.png (1200x800), cover.png (1200x630), avatar.png (480²), logo.png (480x240). NO SVG anywhere (dangerouslyAllowSVG OFF). Regenerate with `node scripts/gen-assets.mjs`.

CONFIG INVARIANTS: next.config.ts images.remotePatterns = https *.public.blob.vercel-storage.com ONLY, dangerouslyAllowSVG:false (explicit). .eslintrc.json extends next/core-web-vitals + prettier + no-restricted-imports forbidding '**/lib/airtable/client', '@/lib/airtable/client', and 'airtable' outside src/lib/airtable/** (override turns the rule off inside that dir). tailwind.config.ts carries the §16 tokens (bg/surface/card/border/text/muted/brand 50-900/depth + accent amber/red/green/blue), fixed type scale (display-1/2/3,h1-h4,body,small), and font vars. globals.css declares the tokens as CSS custom properties + skip-link + prefers-reduced-motion guard. layout.tsx wires next/font/google Inter/Plus Jakarta Sans/JetBrains Mono as CSS vars, dark <html>, metadataBase (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL->VERCEL_URL->localhost), skip-to-content link. .env.example documents every §20 var as optional. README.md carries the accepted FR-24.4 reading verbatim.

NOTE for later FEATs: `next lint` warns it is deprecated in Next 16 (still works in 15). zod is v3 (NOT v4) — write schemas against the v3 API. framer-motion is v14 and lucide-react is v1 (registry latest at install time).
